description: Format and lint JavaScript, Python, or HubL code for Zapier, n8n, Pipedream, Make, or HubSpot. Wraps the source in each platform's runtime shell before formatting so top-level await, bare return, and injected globals don't break the formatter. Returns formatted code plus lint diagnostics.

language.description: Defaults to javascript. zapier, n8n, pipedream, make, and hubspot support python; hubl does not.

name: format_code

diagnostics.description: Lint findings with line and column.

diagnostics_frame.description: Whether diagnostic positions refer to the submitted code or the formatted code.

error.description: Why the format failed, or null on success.

formatted_code.description: The formatted source. Absent when the input was refused.

title: Format code for automation platforms
